summary: Agassi Sports Entertainment Corp. filed an 8-K to report an amendment to a previously disclosed Registration Rights Agreement. The amendment extends the filing deadline for a resale registration statement covering shares sold in a June 2026 Rule 506(b) private placement from July 6, 2026 to July 31, 2026. No material economic terms, merger, acquisition, or change of control are involved. This is a routine contractual modification related to an existing securities offering, not a special situation.
